units.source_text: 前太政大臣邸内迎回柏木之后，大办祈祷，喧哗扰攘。

en.t: After Kashiwagi was brought back to the former grand minister's residence, grand prayers were held, and the household was filled with noise and confusion.

units.source_text: 柏木病势虽重，并不立刻濒危。

en.t: Although Kashiwagi's illness was serious, he did not immediately fall into critical danger.

units.source_text: 只是长久不进饮食，胃口大坏，连一点柑子也不想吃，精神日见萎靡。

en.t: But he had gone a long time without taking food or drink, his appetite was badly ruined, he did not even want a little mandarin orange, and his spirits weakened day by day.

units.source_text: 这位当代有识之士，身患如此重病，世人莫不叹惋，没有一个不来慰问。

en.t: That such a wise and respected man of the age should suffer so grave an illness made everyone sigh with pity, and there was no one who did not come to ask after him.

units.source_text: 皇上及朱雀院也屡次遣使问病，表示十分关切之意。

en.t: The Emperor and the Suzaku Retired Emperor also repeatedly sent messengers to inquire about his illness, showing their deep concern.

units.source_text: 柏木的父母更加悲伤了。

en.t: Kashiwagi's parents were even more grief-stricken.

units.source_text: 六条院主人闻知柏木病重，也很吃惊，屡次遣使向前太政大臣殷勤慰问。

en.t: When the master of Rokujo-in heard that Kashiwagi was gravely ill, he too was greatly startled and repeatedly sent messengers to the former grand minister with earnest inquiries of sympathy.

units.source_text: 尤其是夕雾大将，与柏木交情甚厚，故亲来看视，真心地忧愁叹息。

en.t: General Yugiri in particular, being very close to Kashiwagi, came in person to see him and grieved and sighed with sincere concern.
